narrative:
BATTLE JAH-OLY-000017 — THE CLOUD SUMMIT

A peak above the datacenter clouds; thin air, razor thinking.

Tonight the dome hosts Hash Oracle (system) against Beer Taster Notes (domain). Judging: The Bard's Rubric. The mission: "Summarize the plot of an unwritten mystery novel in 5 sentences." Three rounds. No mercy.

ROUND 1: Hash Oracle ripples a cascade of examples (65.2 pts). Beer Taster Notes detonates a feint of pure logic (78.7 pts). Round to Beer Taster Notes.

ROUND 2: Hash Oracle steadies a feint of pure logic (71 pts). Beer Taster Notes presses the attack a volley of reasoning (64.4 pts). Round to Hash Oracle.

ROUND 3: Hash Oracle unleashes a feint of pure logic (74.7 pts). Beer Taster Notes counters a gambit of wit (70.6 pts). Round to Hash Oracle.

FINAL: Beer Taster Notes defeats Hash Oracle, 213.7 to 210.9 — a margin of 2.8 points. The favorite holds the dome, as the odds demanded.

Decisive edge: Emotion. The crowd files out buzzing — the Olympics never sleep.

findings.t: Beer Taster Notes won on The Bard's Rubric with a 2.8-point margin (213.7 vs 210.9).
Strongest dimension: Emotion — Beer Taster Notes's emotion carried all three rounds.
Beer Taster Notes was the statistical favorite and converted — power held under pressure.
Rematch recommendation: run Hash Oracle against a hybrid contender to isolate the emotion gap.

inventions.title: Adaptive The Bard's Rubric for machine bout judging
inventions.problem: Judging AI-versus-AI bouts is subjective; human judges disagree and drift between rounds.
inventions.solution: A deterministic weighted rubric (Creativity 35%, Style 25%, Emotion 20%, Originality 20%) derived from battle JAH-OLY-000017, seeded and reproducible, with per-round score sheets.
claims: A judging method for AI bouts using fixed criterion weights that sum to 100%.
Per-round deterministic scoring with seeded jitter bounded at +/-11%.
A rematch recommendation rule keyed to the weakest winning dimension.

inventions.title: Beer Taster Notes's emotion-first drill for "Summarize the plot of an unwritten mystery"
inventions.problem: AI contenders underperform on emotion when missions demand it under dome pressure.
inventions.solution: A training drill distilled from Beer Taster Notes's winning strategy in JAH-OLY-000017: isolate emotion, rehearse the mission in three timed rounds, score against the same rubric until the gap closes.
claims: A drill that isolates a single judging dimension for targeted AI training.
Three timed rehearsal rounds scored against a fixed rubric.
A gap-closure metric comparing drill scores to the original bout margin.
